summary: mabinogion chunk 023 is a degenerate '.' chunk — section-split regex matches tale title in closing formula, truncating chunk 022

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content: The Lady of the Fountain ends with the closing formula 'And this is the tale of THE LADY OF THE FOUNTAIN.' — the regex-section-split alternation in chunking/celtic/mabinogion.toml matches the all-caps title inside that sentence, splitting a spurious section whose only content is the trailing period (chunk 023, token_count=1). Side effect: chunk 022 ends mid-sentence at 'And this is the tale of'. Verified in raw/celtic/mabinogion.txt that only this title recurs in-body; the other 12 titles each appear exactly once, so 023 is the only degenerate chunk. Fix: add negative lookbehind (?<!tale of ) to the pattern, re-chunk mabinogion, then re-run clean_bodies.py --apply --text per re-chunk convention.
